title: URL "v3/food" does not contain "{identifier}"
body: Reporting bugs -------------- - **N/A (I think that this problem might not be time related. But maybe it can be reproduced** Maybe the source of this problem could be a discrepancy between the fields denominations for the local AAPS food table and the fields denomination for the corresponding table inside the Nightscout upstream database. - AAPS build number: Major: 3.3.2.1 (Minor: 446cf04460-2025.10.07) - Log (Filtered with occurrences from the NSClient 'module') [AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23690457/AndroidAPS.log), *Note* I only noticed this issue because there is a persistent queue of 1001 elements waiting to be 'delivered' (I think it is from the upstream database) onto the local database, on the NSV3 tab: This is an 'offspring' from my FB post: [https://www.facebook.com/groups/AndroidAPSUsers/?multi_permalinks=4319289694959081](url)...
